summary_en: FY3/27 full-year dividend per share raised to 111.87 yen from 101.21 yen, reflecting upward revision of consolidated earnings guidance (net income to parents 105.0B yen from 95.0B yen) driven by higher investment yields following Bank of Japan policy rate increase in June 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Performance Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) for FY3/27
translation_en_brief: Mebuki Financial Group raised its FY3/27 (year ending March 2027) full-year dividend per share guidance to 111.87 yen from the previously announced 101.21 yen. The increase accompanies an upward revision of consolidated earnings forecasts: net income attributable to parents of the parent company is now projected at 105.0 billion yen (previously 95.0 billion yen), a 10.5% increase. The revision reflects higher-than-expected yields on lending and securities holdings, driven by the Bank of Japan's policy rate increase in June 2026. The subsidiary banks—Joyo Bank and Ashikaga Bank—similarly raised earnings outlooks. The hike represents a reinstatement of growth in shareholder distributions after prior guidance.
